fields.label: Site Logo
fields.name: site_logo
fields.instructions: Upload or choose the primary website logo. If empty, the WordPress Customizer logo will be used.

fields.label: Top Bar Right Phone Number
fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.instructions: Used by the top bar call icon and WhatsApp contact links.

fields.label: WhatsApp Button Text
fields.name: whatsapp_button_text
fields.instructions: Button text for the WhatsApp button in the header (e.g. 'WhatsApp' or 'Chat on WhatsApp').

fields.label: WhatsApp Button URL / Link
fields.name: whatsapp_button_url
fields.instructions: Optional custom URL or link for the WhatsApp button (e.g. https://wa.me/61488841833 or phone number). If left blank, it defaults to the WhatsApp number above.

fields.label: Nav Submenu Catalogue Title
fields.name: nav_dropdown_title
fields.instructions: Header title shown at the top of the product mega-dropdown. Leave this and the badge empty to hide the whole strip.

fields.label: Nav Submenu Badge Text
fields.name: nav_dropdown_badge
fields.instructions: Badge text displayed in the header strip of the mega-dropdown. Leave this and the title empty to hide the whole strip.

fields.label: Nav Submenu Footer Perk Text
fields.name: nav_dropdown_footer_perk
fields.instructions: Delivery guarantee or perk text shown in the mega-dropdown footer strip.
fields.default_value: Free Express Delivery on Orders Over $299
fields.placeholder: Free Express Delivery on Orders Over $299

fields.label: Nav Submenu Footer Button Label
fields.name: nav_dropdown_shop_label
fields.instructions: Label for the CTA button in the mega-dropdown footer.

fields.label: Nav Submenu Footer Button URL
fields.name: nav_dropdown_shop_url
fields.instructions: Custom URL for the footer button. If empty, defaults to the WooCommerce Shop page.

fields.label: Dropdown Best Seller Products
fields.name: nav_best_seller_products
fields.instructions: Choose which products display the "Best Seller" badge in the navigation dropdown catalogue. Admin can select or remove products at any time.

fields.label: Support Email
fields.name: support_email
fields.instructions: Used for the support contact address.

fields.label: Working Days
fields.name: working_days
fields.instructions: Displayed in the footer contact section (e.g. 'Monday to Sunday').

fields.label: Office Hours
fields.name: office_hours
fields.instructions: Displayed in the footer contact section (e.g. '24/7').

fields.label: Product Trust Badges
fields.message: Customize the 3 trust badges displayed below the "Buy now" button on all single product pages. Leave fields empty to keep default values.

fields.label: Footer Logo
fields.name: footer_logo
fields.instructions: Optional footer logo. If empty, the primary site logo will be used.

fields.label: Footer Description
fields.name: footer_description
fields.default_value: Steady focus, cleaner clarity, and dependable dispatch — built for Australian customers who take their day seriously.

fields.label: Location / Address Text
fields.name: location_text
fields.instructions: Address displayed in the footer contact block.

fields.label: Contact Section Heading
fields.name: footer_contact_heading
fields.instructions: Heading displayed above contact information in footer.

fields.label: Payment Accepted Heading
fields.name: footer_payments_heading
fields.instructions: Heading displayed above payment method logos in footer.

fields.label: Payment Accepted Logos
fields.name: footer_payment_images
fields.instructions: Upload accepted payment logos (e.g. Commonwealth Bank, Osko, PayID). If left empty, default Australian bank and payment logos are displayed.

fields.label: Shipping Partner Heading
fields.name: footer_shipping_heading
fields.instructions: Heading displayed above shipping partner logos in footer.

fields.label: Shipping Partner Logos
fields.name: footer_shipping_images
fields.instructions: Upload shipping partner logos (e.g. Australia Post). If left empty, default Australia Post logo is displayed.

fields.label: Copyright Text
fields.name: copyright_text
fields.default_value: © 2026 Armodafinil. Information only — not medical advice.

fields.label: Disclaimer
fields.name: disclaimer_en
fields.default_value: This website provides general information only and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified health professional.

fields.label: About this tab
fields.message: Controls the order thank-you page (the WooCommerce order received page) and the bank transfer details. The bank account values below are the single source: the thank-you page and the bank transfer order email both read them. Where a text supports placeholders, they are written in curly brackets, for example {name}.

fields.label: Confirmed Icon
fields.name: ty_confirmed_icon
fields.instructions: Icon in the round badge at the top of the thank-you page. If empty, the bundled check circle icon is used.

fields.label: Confirmed Heading
fields.name: ty_confirmed_heading
fields.instructions: Large heading at the top of the order thank-you page, inside the first card.

fields.label: Confirmed Intro Text
fields.name: ty_confirmed_intro
fields.instructions: First sentence under the heading on the order thank-you page. Placeholder: {name} is replaced by the customer first name (shown in bold).

fields.label: Confirmation Email Note
fields.name: ty_confirmed_email_note
fields.instructions: Second sentence under the heading on the order thank-you page. Only shown when the order has an email address. Placeholder: {email} is replaced by the customer email (shown in bold).

fields.label: Customer Name Fallback
fields.name: ty_confirmed_name_fallback
fields.instructions: Word used for {name} on the order thank-you page when the customer did not enter a first name.

fields.label: Order ID Label
fields.name: ty_order_id_label
fields.instructions: Label in the pill under the intro on the order thank-you page. The order number is added after it.

fields.label: What Happens Next Heading
fields.name: ty_next_heading
fields.instructions: Heading of the numbered steps card on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 1 Label
fields.name: ty_step1_label
fields.instructions: Bold lead-in of step 1 (payment) on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 1 Text: Bank Transfer
fields.name: ty_step1_text_bacs
fields.instructions: Step 1 text on the order thank-you page when the customer chose bank transfer.

fields.label: Step 1 Text: Crypto
fields.name: ty_step1_text_crypto
fields.instructions: Step 1 text on the order thank-you page when the customer chose a crypto payment method.

fields.label: Step 1 Text: Other Payment Methods
fields.name: ty_step1_text_other
fields.instructions: Step 1 text on the order thank-you page for every other payment method (for example card).

fields.label: Step 2 Label
fields.name: ty_step2_label
fields.instructions: Bold lead-in of step 2 (dispatch) on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 2 Text
fields.name: ty_step2_text
fields.instructions: Step 2 text on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 3 Label
fields.name: ty_step3_label
fields.instructions: Bold lead-in of step 3 (tracking) on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 3 Text
fields.name: ty_step3_text
fields.instructions: Step 3 text on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 4 Label
fields.name: ty_step4_label
fields.instructions: Bold lead-in of step 4 (delivery) on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Step 4 Text
fields.name: ty_step4_text
fields.instructions: Step 4 text on the order thank-you page.

fields.label: Bank transfer, PayID and payment instructions
Bank Transfer Instructions
fields.name: bank_transfer_instructions
fields.instructions: Paragraph shown above the bank details on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email (replaces the Instructions box in WooCommerce > Payments > Direct bank transfer). Leave empty to show no paragraph.

fields.label: Bank Details Heading
fields.name: bank_card_heading
fields.instructions: Heading of the bank details block on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email.

fields.label: Bank Name
fields.name: bank_transfer_bank_name
fields.instructions: Bank shown in the bank details on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email. WooCommerce reads this value for the bank transfer payment method, so this is the only place to edit it.

fields.label: Account Holder Name
fields.name: bank_transfer_account_name
fields.instructions: Account holder shown above the bank details on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email.

fields.label: BSB
fields.name: bank_transfer_bsb
fields.instructions: BSB shown in the bank details on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email.

fields.label: Account Number
fields.name: bank_transfer_account_number
fields.instructions: Account number shown in the bank details on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email.

fields.label: PayID
fields.name: bank_transfer_payid
fields.instructions: PayID shown after the bank details on the order thank-you page and in the bank transfer order email. Leave empty to hide the PayID line.

fields.label: Label: Bank
fields.name: bank_label_bank
fields.instructions: Label in front of the bank name in the bank details (thank-you page and bank transfer email).

fields.label: Label: Account Number
fields.name: bank_label_account_number
fields.instructions: Label in front of the account number in the bank details (thank-you page and bank transfer email).

fields.label: Label: BSB
fields.name: bank_label_bsb
fields.instructions: Label in front of the BSB in the bank details (thank-you page and bank transfer email).

fields.label: Label: PayID
fields.name: bank_label_payid
fields.instructions: Label in front of the PayID in the bank details (thank-you page and bank transfer email).

fields.label: Continue Shopping Button Label
fields.name: ty_continue_label
fields.instructions: Main button at the bottom of the order thank-you page, and the button on the page shown when no order is found. Links to the shop page.

fields.label: Continue Shopping Button Icon
fields.name: ty_continue_icon
fields.instructions: Icon after the Continue shopping label on the order thank-you page. If empty, the bundled arrow is used.

fields.label: Back To Home Button Label
fields.name: ty_home_label
fields.instructions: Second button at the bottom of the order thank-you page. Links to the home page.

fields.label: Back To Home Button Icon
fields.name: ty_home_icon
fields.instructions: Icon before the Back to home label on the order thank-you page. If empty, the bundled home icon is used.

fields.label: Failed Payment Message
fields.name: ty_failed_message
fields.instructions: Red message shown on the order thank-you page when the payment failed.

fields.label: Failed Payment: Pay Button Label
fields.name: ty_failed_pay_label
fields.instructions: Button on the failed payment message of the order thank-you page. Links to the order payment page.

fields.label: Failed Payment: My Account Button Label
fields.name: ty_failed_account_label
fields.instructions: Second button on the failed payment message of the order thank-you page. Only shown to logged in customers.

fields.label: No Order Found: Heading
fields.name: ty_notfound_heading
fields.instructions: Heading of the page shown when the order thank-you URL has no valid order.

fields.label: No Order Found: Message
fields.name: ty_notfound_message
fields.instructions: Text of the page shown when the order thank-you URL has no valid order.
